verdict.rationale: Chronicle has a documented API reference: scoped API keys for CI and agent processes, idempotent retries that return the original world or run, a REST endpoint (POST /v1/search), and SDKs in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go and Rust that expose the same resources. Together these show the core platform (worlds, runs, agents, traces) can be driven programmatically. The 404 on the OpenAPI probe does not contradict the documented API; it only means no machine-readable spec was found at the paths tried. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, explicit endpoint documentation for world-building and evaluation runs (only one REST endpoint is shown verbatim), and independent hands-on corroboration.
